name: Bonchon Chicken
notes: 3 of 3 photos were menus (a close-up of the Starters section, a Korean Fried Chicken trifold brochure, and a full printed menu page). Prices for Korean Tacos, Sliders and Pork Buns differ slightly across the three photos (likely different print runs); used the full menu page (photo 3) as the canonical source since it lists the most dishes, and merged unique items from the fried-chicken brochure (photo 2). Dips/add-ons and calorie counts were skipped as modifiers.
